Report the numerical LUMO in Hartree (Ha), distinguishing a calculated result from a database record."}

The SELFIES string decodes to `CC12C3OC(C)(C13)C2O`. Its reported canonical SMILES is `CC12OC3C1C3(C)C2O`, and its InChIKey is `IYMJXIQNCWZTBD-UHFFFAOYSA-N`.
